title: Drift inspector
author: JG
description: add functionality to check whether drift gets too large
releaseNotes: the drift of the constraints: generalizedAlpha.checkConstraintDrift checks the position-level constraints every constraintDriftCheckPeriod steps, warns at 0.001 constraintDriftTolerance and stops above it (default 1e-5), the largest drift in the solver output; SolveDynamic switches it on for TrapezoidalIndex2 (index2CheckConstraints); mbs.ComputeConstraintResiduals, ComputeItemType.ConstraintDrift and AlgebraicEquations_t, the output variable ConstraintEquation of every constraint, the sensor function SensorUFSystemConstraintDrift; test model constraintDriftTest.py (revision2026c steps RG4.25.1, RG4.25.2)
